criteria.criterion: Contract and isolation: reset/step shapes, schemas, limits, completion, invalid input, no truth leaks (20 fixed checks)
Data and truth: books balanced before injection, declared discrepancy after, independently sufficient evidence (20 closed episodes)
Reward reliability: matching, clean cases, false positives, duplicates, cost, adversarial answers (20 checks)
Reproducibility and generalization: exact replay, id and order permutation preserve oracle answer and reward (20 paired checks)
Engineering and explanation: one-command launch, config versions, trajectory logs, measured failure analysis, honest limitations (5 x 0/1/2)
